headingTree.text: Upload documents in support of identity and address

text: Unique Identification Authority of India myAadhaar English English हिंदी বাংলা ಕನ್ನಡ ગુજરાતી മലയാളം मराठी ଓଡ଼ିଆ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ தமிழ் తెలుగు اردو Upload documents in support of identity and address Free till 14/06/2027 What to submit? Ration card, Voter identity card, Government-issued identity card/ certificate having address, and Indian Passport serve as proof of both identity and address. PAN card, Driving license, Secondary or Senior School mark sheet/ School leaving certificate having photograph, Government-issued identity card/ certificate - serve as only proof of identity. Electricity/water/gas bill (last 3 months), Bank / Post Office passbook, rent/ lease/ leave & license agreement serve as proof of address only. For detailed list of acceptable identity and address documents, please click here. How to submit? The documents can be submitted online on myAadhaar portal or by visiting any Aadhaar centre. For step by step procedure for submission of documents online please click here. Click To Submit Need Help? Video guide Know More? Call toll-free (1947)
